about: CloudEvents vectors (ledger #4117) computed from tests/vectors/cloudevents_cases.json by crates/ikigai-events-cloudevents/tests/vectors.rs, which fails if this file differs from what it computes. Every input is TEXT, its bytes the input. Where the crate refuses, the outputs are null and `refusal` holds its one sentence; a face must refuse exactly there, and matching the sentence byte for byte is recommended. `events`: one event read, written back (`json`), keyed (`key`, the identifiers crate's event key), named (`node`) and lifted (`turtle`), with what it gives an intake. `batches`: a batch read, written back and lifted. `turtle`: a form lowered to a batch. Every `turtle` an event or batch row holds lowers back to that row's `json`.

batches.name: two
a-redelivery-inside-one-batch
same-source-and-id-but-different
batches.refusal: Two events share the `source` `https://example.com/sensors/tn-1234567` and the `id` `1` but differ: an event's `source` and `id` name it, so send one of them.

batches.name: a-member-not-an-object
batches.refusal: A batch holds a number, not an event: every member of a batch is one JSON object.

batches.name: an-object
batches.refusal: The content is an object, not a batch: the JSON batch format is one JSON array of events.

events.name: minimal
full
ikigai-layer-entry
ikigai-transition
binary-data
null-is-absent
relative-source-and-unicode-id
later-traceparent-version
lowercase-t-and-z
data-at-the-nesting-bound
no-type
events.refusal: An event has no `type`: every CloudEvent carries `specversion`, `id`, `source` and `type`.

events.name: wrong-specversion
events.refusal: `0.3` is not a CloudEvents version these attributes follow: send `specversion` `1.0`.

events.name: empty-id
events.refusal: An event's `id` is empty: name the event within its source.

events.name: id-not-a-string
events.refusal: An event's `id` is a number, not a string: send it as a JSON string.

events.name: source-with-space
events.refusal: `urn:has space` is not a URI-reference: send `source` as an absolute or relative URI in ASCII, percent-encoding anything else.

events.name: source-not-ascii
events.refusal: `https://exämple.com/` is not a URI-reference: send `source` as an absolute or relative URI in ASCII, percent-encoding anything else.

events.name: time-without-offset
events.refusal: `2026-11-23T20:00:00` is not an RFC 3339 time: send `time` as a date-time with an offset, such as `2026-11-23T20:00:00Z`.

events.name: time-not-a-time
events.refusal: `yesterday` is not an RFC 3339 time: send `time` as a date-time with an offset, such as `2026-11-23T20:00:00Z`.

events.name: dataschema-relative
events.refusal: `/schema.json` is not an absolute URI: send `dataschema` as a URI with a scheme, in ASCII.

events.name: traceparent-uppercase
events.refusal: `00-4BF92F3577B34DA6A3CE929D0E0E4736-00F067AA0BA902B7-01` is not a W3C `traceparent`: send `{version}-{trace-id}-{parent-id}-{flags}` in lowercase hex, 2, 32, 16 and 2 digits.

events.name: traceparent-version-ff
events.refusal: `ff-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01` is not a W3C `traceparent`: version `ff` is never valid.

events.name: traceparent-zero-trace
events.refusal: `00-00000000000000000000000000000000-00f067aa0ba902b7-01` is not a W3C `traceparent`: its trace id is all zeros.

events.name: traceparent-zero-parent
events.refusal: `00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-0000000000000000-01` is not a W3C `traceparent`: its parent id is all zeros.

events.name: traceparent-version-00-too-long
events.refusal: `00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01-x` is not a W3C `traceparent`: a version `00` value is exactly 55 characters.

events.name: ikseq-a-number
events.refusal: An event's `ikseq` is a number: send it as a string of decimal digits, because a CloudEvents Integer is 32-bit and a feed position is 64-bit.

events.name: ikseq-zero
events.refusal: `0` is not a sequence number: a feed's positions start at 1.

events.name: ikepoch-without-ikseq
events.refusal: An event names an `ikepoch` with no `ikseq`: send both, or neither.

events.name: extension-name-uppercase
events.refusal: `Region` is not a CloudEvents attribute name: use lowercase ASCII letters and digits only.

events.name: extension-name-underscore
events.refusal: `region_name` is not a CloudEvents attribute name: use lowercase ASCII letters and digits only.

events.name: extension-a-fraction
events.refusal: An event's `ratio` is 0.5, which is not a CloudEvents Integer: send a whole number from -2147483648 to 2147483647, or a string.

events.name: extension-past-32-bits
events.refusal: An event's `big` is 2147483648, which is not a CloudEvents Integer: send a whole number from -2147483648 to 2147483647, or a string.

events.name: extension-an-object
events.refusal: An event's extension `meta` is an object: send a string, a boolean or an integer.

events.name: both-data-and-data-base64
events.refusal: An event carries both `data` and `data_base64`: send one of them.

events.name: data-base64-unpadded
events.refusal: `aGVsbG8` is not base64: send `data_base64` in RFC 4648's standard alphabet, padded with `=`.

events.name: empty-subject
events.refusal: An event's `subject` is empty: leave it out, or give it a value.

events.name: data-past-the-nesting-bound
events.refusal: The content nests JSON objects and arrays deeper than 64: flatten the event's data, or send it as `data_base64`.

events.name: an-array
events.refusal: The content is an array, not a CloudEvent: the JSON event format is one JSON object.

events.name: not-json
events.refusal: The content is not JSON: EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 15.

turtle.name: a-foreign-node
turtle.refusal: `urn:x` is not an event's node: the form names each event `urn:iki:event:key:b3:{hex}`, from its `source` and `id`.

turtle.name: a-blank-node
turtle.refusal: The content has a blank node: the form names every event, so send it without one.

turtle.name: a-property-outside-the-form
turtle.refusal: `http://purl.org/dc/terms/created` is not a property of the form: every property is `ce:` and an attribute's name.

turtle.name: not-turtle
turtle.refusal: The content is not Turtle: Parser error at line 1 column 27: Unexpected end of file.
